육.forms: Sino-Korean · dates, money, minutes, phone numbers, floors (육 층) · June: 유월
육.x: Our home is on the sixth floor.
육.t: June is 유월, not 육월. 16 (십육) is pronounced [심뉵].

노래방.ex: 친구들하고 노래방에 가서 두 시간 동안 노래했어요.
노래방.x: I went to a karaoke room with friends and sang for two hours.
노래방.t: Korean karaoke happens in private rooms; going to 노래방 is a classic after-dinner activity with friends or coworkers.

그렇다.m: to be so, to be like that
그렇다.x: Yes, that's right. I think so too.
그렇다.e: Short for 그러하다, 'be that way'; part of the set 이렇다, 그렇다, 저렇다.
그렇다.t: 그래요? = Really? and 그래요 = Okay / That's right — two of the most useful replies.

장난감.ex: 아이가 생일 선물로 장난감을 받고 좋아했어요.
장난감.x: The child got a toy as a birthday present and was happy.
장난감.e: 장난 'play, mischief' + 감 'material', so literally 'stuff to play with'.

충고.x: I listened to my senior's advice and changed my plan.
충고.e: Literally 'loyal telling' — honest words for someone's own good.
충고.t: 충고 often points out a fault; 조언 is softer, helpful advice.

불면증.x: I developed insomnia because of stress.
불면증.e: Literally 'not-sleeping condition'; -증 = medical condition: 우울증, 건망증.
불면증.t: The common pattern is 불면증에 시달리다, 'to suffer from insomnia'.

평가.ex: 그 식당은 손님들에게 좋은 평가를 받았어요.
평가.x: That restaurant got good reviews from customers.

협의.x: I'll decide that after discussing it with the team.
협의.t: 협의 is the process of talking it over; 합의 is the agreement you reach.

협의.x: In the narrow sense, culture means the arts and scholarship.
협의.t: Homonym 협의 also means 'consultation'; 협의의 N or 협의로 signals the 'narrow sense' meaning.

측.ex: 회사 측은 아직 공식 입장을 밝히지 않았어요.
측.x: The company's side has not yet given an official position.
측.t: Comes after a group name with a space: 회사 측, 경찰 측, 피해자 측 — formal; casual speech uses 쪽.

폭발.x: A big explosion happened at the factory last night.
폭발.t: Also figurative: 인기 폭발 'explosive popularity', 화가 폭발하다 'to explode with anger'.

공해.x: City noise is also a kind of pollution.
공해.e: Literally 'public harm'; a different 공해 means 'international waters'.
공해.t: Noise and light count too: 소음 공해 = noise pollution, 빛 공해 = light pollution.

마지막으로.forms: 마지막으로 + final point: 마지막으로 한 가지만 말씀드릴게요
마지막으로.m: lastly, finally, for the last time
마지막으로.ex: 마지막으로 질문이 있으면 지금 해 주세요.
마지막으로.x: Lastly, if you have any questions, please ask them now.

촉구하다.m: to urge, to call for, to press for
촉구하다.ex: 시민 단체는 정부에 빠른 대책을 촉구했습니다.
촉구하다.x: Civic groups urged the government to take quick measures.

보잘것없다.x: It's just a humble gift, but please accept it.
보잘것없다.e: Built from 보다 'to see' + 것 + 없다 — 'nothing worth looking at'.
보잘것없다.t: Often used modestly about your own things; pronounced [보잘꺼덥따].

낙찰.m: winning a bid, award of a contract
낙찰.x: That painting sold at auction for one billion won.
낙찰.e: Literally 'the bid slip falls' to the winner.
낙찰.t: 낙찰되다 = to be sold or awarded to the winning bidder; 낙찰받다 = to win the bid.

분단국가.x: Korea still remains a divided nation.
분단국가.t: Pronounced [분단국까] — 가 is tensed after ㄱ.

공존.ex: 인간과 자연의 공존을 위해 노력해야 합니다.
공존.x: We must work toward the coexistence of humans and nature.

본질적으로.ex: 두 제품은 디자인만 다르고 본질적으로 같아요.
본질적으로.x: The two products differ only in design; they're essentially the same.

어불성설.m: nonsense; an argument that doesn't hold up
어불성설.ex: 아무 노력 없이 성공하겠다는 것은 어불성설이에요.
어불성설.x: Expecting to succeed without any effort is nonsense.
어불성설.e: Literally 'the words don't make an argument.'
어불성설.t: Formal and argumentative; in casual talk people just say 말도 안 돼요.

횡설수설.x: He was so nervous that he rambled incoherently in the interview.
횡설수설.e: Literally 'talking sideways, talking up and down.'

개구리 올챙이 적 생각 못 한다.de: 개구리 올챙이 적 생각 못 한다
개구리 올챙이 적 생각 못 한다.forms: 개구리 올챙이 적 생각 못 한다더니 · 개구리 올챙이 적 생각 못 하네요
개구리 올챙이 적 생각 못 한다.m: to forget one's humble beginnings; said of someone who succeeds and looks down on beginners
개구리 올챙이 적 생각 못 한다.ex: 개구리 올챙이 적 생각 못 한다더니, 선배가 신입 사원 실수를 너무 비난해요.
개구리 올챙이 적 생각 못 한다.x: He's forgotten where he came from; our senior criticizes new employees' mistakes way too harshly.
개구리 올챙이 적 생각 못 한다.e: Literally 'the frog can't remember when it was a tadpole.'
개구리 올챙이 적 생각 못 한다.t: Said in one breath as [개구리 올챙이쩍 생각 모탄다]: 적 sounds like [쩍] after 올챙이, and 못 한다 runs together as [모탄다].

심리학자.ex: 그 심리학자는 어린이의 감정 발달을 연구하고 있어요.
심리학자.x: That psychologist is researching children's emotional development.
심리학자.e: Literally 'person who studies the principles of the mind'. -학자 = scholar: 역사학자, 경제학자.
심리학자.t: Pronounced [심니학짜] — ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅁ, and ㅈ tenses after ㄱ.

양해하다.m: to understand and excuse, to be understanding
양해하다.x: Please excuse me for getting back to you late.
양해하다.t: Polite set phrase: 양해 부탁드립니다, 'Thank you for your understanding.'

막무가내.m: being impossible to reason with, stubbornly insisting no matter what
막무가내.ex: 아이가 장난감을 사 달라고 막무가내로 떼를 썼어요.
막무가내.x: The child threw a tantrum, flatly insisting I buy him a toy.
막무가내.e: Literally 'there is no way at all to deal with it' (莫 'none', 無 'without', 可奈 'how one could cope') — someone nobody can do anything with.
막무가내.t: Pronounced [망무가내]. Usually 막무가내로 + 우기다/떼를 쓰다/조르다, or as a predicate: 막무가내예요.

협치.x: The ruling and opposition parties promised to cooperate for people's livelihoods.
협치.e: Literally 'governing together'; a fairly recent buzzword in Korean politics.

엽관제.m: spoils system (handing out government jobs to party supporters)
엽관제.ex: 엽관제는 선거에서 이긴 정당이 공직을 나누어 주는 제도예요.
엽관제.x: The spoils system is a system in which the party that wins the election hands out public posts.
엽관제.e: Literally 'office-hunting system' — winners hunt for government posts as their spoils.

지정학적.ex: 한국은 지정학적 위치 때문에 강대국 사이에서 어려움을 겪었어요.
지정학적.x: Because of its geopolitical location, Korea has had difficulties between great powers.
지정학적.e: -적 turns a noun into '-ic/-al': 지정학 to 지정학적.
지정학적.t: Used directly before nouns (지정학적 위치) or with -으로 / -인: 지정학적으로 중요한.

선험적.ex: 칸트는 시간과 공간을 선험적 형식으로 보았어요.
선험적.x: Kant saw time and space as a priori forms.
선험적.e: Literally 'before-experience', a direct match for Latin 'a priori'.

설의법.ex: '이게 사랑이 아니면 무엇이랴'는 설의법이 쓰인 문장이에요.
설의법.x: 'If this isn't love, what is?' is a sentence using a rhetorical question.
설의법.e: Literally 'set-up-doubt method' — asking a question whose answer is obvious.

역서.ex: 그 학자는 자기 저서보다 역서가 더 많아요.
역서.x: That scholar has more translated books than books of his own.
역서.t: Pronounced [역써]; contrast with 저서 'book one wrote.'

각별하다.ex: 두 사람은 어릴 때부터 각별한 사이였어요.
각별하다.x: The two of them have been especially close since childhood.
각별하다.e: Literally 'each set apart' — treated as special.

무릇.m: generally, as a rule (opening a general truth)
무릇.x: As a rule, people should live honestly.
무릇.e: A literary opener for universal statements, like English 'As a rule' or 'In general'.

저출생.ex: 저출생 문제를 해결하기 위해 정부가 새 대책을 발표했습니다.
저출생.x: The government announced new measures to solve the low birth rate problem.
저출생.t: Same meaning as 저출산; 저출생 is newer and seen as more neutral, since it doesn't focus on mothers.

광의.x: In the broad sense, education also includes upbringing at home.
광의.t: Usually 광의의 N, or 광의로 보면, 'broadly speaking.'

공짜라면 양잿물도 마신다.forms: 공짜라면 양잿물도 마신다더니 · 공짜라면 양잿물도 마신다고
공짜라면 양잿물도 마신다.m: people will take anything if it's free (lit. if it's free, one would even drink lye)
공짜라면 양잿물도 마신다.ex: 공짜라면 양잿물도 마신다더니, 무료 시식 코너에 사람들이 길게 줄을 섰어요.
공짜라면 양잿물도 마신다.x: People will take anything that's free: there was a long line at the free-sample counter.
공짜라면 양잿물도 마신다.e: 양잿물 is lye, a caustic cleaning liquid (양 'Western' + 잿물 'ash water'): if it were free, people would drink even that.
공짜라면 양잿물도 마신다.t: Pronounced [공짜라면 양잰물도 마신다]. A humorous, slightly mocking comment on people who grab anything free; also said self-mockingly.
nb: 열 길 물속은 알아도 한 길 사람 속은 모른다
